superseded_execution.disposition: Discarded on the owner's instruction rather than kept as a pre-b101ada record. 536a3ae is not reachable from main and no provenance tag holds it, so the shas naming that execution will stop resolving once the objects are collected. This is deliberate — nothing cites them.

stages.note: Own CSV (results-arbiter-probe.csv) and configs (configs-arbiter-probe/), shared with no other profile. jobs=1 for ltlsynt RAM, as with every TLSF profile; the ltl2tgba orphan-reaper cron was verified installed on both hosts before launch.

config_vintage.elitism_rate: Pinned to 0.1 in the emitted config rather than inherited. 2026-08-07-elitism closed on 2026-08-10 keeping 0.1 on cost alone, so the pin and the current default agree; the pin is kept regardless, because gen_configs.py writes a key only where a sweep overrides it and an inherited value would leave this archive restating whatever the binary later defaults to.
config_vintage.metric: The emitted config pins model_counting.metric = "direct", where config.hpp defaults to Logarithmic. This is the gen_configs.py campaign baseline that every prior sweep shares, including 2026-07-31-replicate, whose finding this campaign extends. Matching the campaign under test was preferred to matching the shipped default; see PLAN.md §4.
config_vintage.unpinned: run_vacuity and run_well_separation are deliberately left unpinned and take the binary's defaults at df66e44: run_vacuity true, run_well_separation FALSE. The latter is the second move of a key that has now crossed the line twice — false before 86e463c, true between it and b101ada, false again from b101ada, which folded the property into the status score. Reproducing this campaign means building df66e44; writing the key back at any single value does not reconstruct it, because b101ada also changed what the status scale means and no config key restores that.

comparability.to_2026-07-31-replicate: Not comparable row for row. The engine has since gained the tautology screen (3869c53), the fold of the false-condition filter into vacuity, the correct-offspring rescue fix, the flip of run_well_separation and allow_output_assumptions to true (86e463c) and its partial reversal (b101ada), the shared correctness gate on written repairs (d7733fc), and the weak-until rewrite before black (fb4c3ed). The last three postdate this campaign's own first execution. Both arms here are collected fresh at one commit, so the paired within-campaign comparison is internally valid and no cross-campaign join is required by the decision rule.
comparability.selection_scheme_names: This is the first campaign archived under the post-2026-08-06 spellings. Its configs set nsga2-truncate and nsga2-apportion, and its CSV selection column reads the same, so canonical_scheme() is an identity on these rows rather than a rename.
